id="notes" value="UML entity model: solid lines are associations; multiplicities describe the named roles, not database integrity. Attributes use [0..1] for optional values and [0..*] for lists. {PK}/{UQ} are schema-key constraints. Enforced relations and scalar-ID mappings are listed below; cross-service IDs are not foreign keys.<br>Solid Mongo associations are ORM relations, not SQL foreign-key constraints. ConversationMember is a parallel membership projection; participantIds remains a canonical contract. User IDs refer to User Service. No RagTrace entity exists in the current local AI schema; Langfuse holds monitoring snapshots.<br>conversation: conversationId: Prisma Mongo association (declared Mongo ORM relation, not SQL FK); conversation: conversationId: Prisma Mongo association (declared Mongo ORM relation, not SQL FK); summary context: conversationId UNIQUE: logical one summary per conversation (scalar-ID association; no declared FK); source<br>conversation: optional sourceConversationId (logical provenance) (scalar-ID association; no declared FK); share context: conversationId: cross-service share context (scalar-ID association; no declared FK); linked message: messageId: optional until Reel message linked (scalar-ID association; no declared FK)" vertex="1" parent="1" style="shape=note;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;overflow=hidden;fontFamily=Arial;fontSize=13;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=12;fillColor=#fff8ed;strokeColor=#687782;"><mxGeometry as="geometry" x="35" y="1149.976" width="2425.968" height="108" /></mxCell></root></mxGraphModel></diagram></mxfile>

xhtml:div.xhtml:div:
UML entity model: solid lines are associations; multiplicities describe the named roles, not database integrity. Attributes use [0..1] for optional values and [0..*] for lists. {PK}/{UQ} are schema-key constraints. Enforced relations and scalar-ID mappings are listed below; cross-service IDs are not foreign keys.
Solid Mongo associations are ORM relations, not SQL foreign-key constraints. ConversationMember is a parallel membership projection; participantIds remains a canonical contract. User IDs refer to User Service. No RagTrace entity exists in the current local AI schema; Langfuse holds monitoring snapshots.
conversation: conversationId: Prisma Mongo association (declared Mongo ORM relation, not SQL FK); conversation: conversationId: Prisma Mongo association (declared Mongo ORM relation, not SQL FK); summary context: conversationId UNIQUE: logical one summary per conversation (scalar-ID association; no declared FK); source
conversation: optional sourceConversationId (logical provenance) (scalar-ID association; no declared FK); share context: conversationId: cross-service share context (scalar-ID association; no declared FK); linked message: messageId: optional until Reel message linked (scalar-ID association; no declared FK)
